title: Hyundai Surreal Dreamscape
description: A glowing blue neon Hyundai logo floats at the center of a surreal, densely layered collage. The composition merges a golden tribal mask, a wide-eyed indigenous child, lush jungle foliage, ancient symbols, bones, and mechanical fragments in a chaotic mystical vision.
prompt: Surreal dense collage painting featuring a glowing bright blue neon circular Hyundai logo floating in the center. Surrounding it are a golden tribal mask with spiral patterns on the left, a young indigenous child with wide eyes wearing a headband, lush ferns and jungle vegetation, scattered ancient symbols and numbers, bones, mechanical parts and an eye at the bottom, all blended in a chaotic mystical dreamlike vision with layered textures and dramatic lighting.
